bio: Winter in the Engadine region promises a host of exciting culinary experiences at the fine dining restaurant of hotel Giardino Mountain here in St Moritz. The cuisine is modern and creative. There is a set menu that comes in four to seven courses, and exceptional ingredients are at the heart of it all. Thanks to the exceedingly dedicated, charming and unflappable front-of-house team, the attentive service matches these high standards....
